mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises at an annual rate exceeding 2% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.5%, it indicates the Federal Reserve is not aggressively tightening policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained accommodative conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 1100), strong residential construction activity signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1100, or the Rank IC for HOUST in the housing boom regime is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 new jobs per month indicates a healthy labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.25 percentage points in the last three months), the Federal Reserve's policy shift reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS increased by >0.25pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 100,000 jobs per month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
